caption: \textbf{Robustness across embedding models.} All erasers are refit in each model's embedding space (not frozen transfer). Each triple reports the change in linear AUC from Raw for PCA-1/$k$-means LEACE (silhouette-selected $K$)/SAE-LEACE ($N{=}32$); $0$ means no change from the raw embeddings. Values average matched differences over seeds 0--2; means and ranges summarize available models. SwiLTra and SCOTUS are shown in the version, among those run with all ten models, where the label-free erasers lower linear AUC most: DE--FR and Oyez--Lexis (mean over models and erasers $-$.350 and $-$.115; DE--FR--IT and Oyez--Lexis--Wikipedia: $-$.220 and $-$.086).
